items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The people there, you remember a fellow by the name of E. Simms Campbell? The cartoonist.

ctx.x: leave this so I could zip. Not the zip, you know, just put it open. I got my horn with me And the levee, and I feel good. We were rugged. It was very rugged country. That was a fur district. You know (fur district one is shoes) From ( ) Washington. ... walking down to the levee. So/night I'm feeling very good. I'm a boy around, I must be around 175 pounds, something like that. I'm in good shape. Everybody was happy at home, like that. And out of nowhere, a guy, somebody grabs me and lifts me off of my feet.…
